author: toketrain
body:
Old Forest


Hello again! My newest map is titled Old Forest. It's quite unique as each quadrant is a cylinder. The cylinders have corners, but you can't go there until the walls drop. It's a large map with good gameplay; before the walls drop, you can explore all areas and find hidden places with good gear, items, etc. You can also mine in the mineshaft, and loot the houses and castle.

Imgur photo album

Mediafire map download (v 2.0)

Updates:

Version 2.0 now available!

==Changes:
-Added more terrain to make it look less flat
-Added lots of flowers and grass
-Added more detail to center

--new pictures!--

replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
The map itself looks pretty good but there is some stuff you should consider improving.

Some parts of the map seem pretty flat.

Here you can see nice mountains and a river in the middle but the grassy area around the river should be terraformed a little bit and elevated so it would give a feeling of it not being so flat.


The whole map seems a little bit too flat. Even a 1 block change in hight can be a huge difference and you should consider terraforming it a little bit more.

Overall the buildings, cave and the mountains look pretty good. Just do some more terraforming overall and not make it so flat (above pictures).

Another thing you should consider working on it the middle between the team sides.

The middle should be detailed a little bit more and you should consider decorating the sand walls a little bit more.

Other than the stuff I mentioned the map looks pretty good and has a lot of potential. Just do some minor modifications and I think you could see it on the servers in the future.

This map was really good:The little details that you added are really good! You made small trees and flowers on the ground as i can see, with ravines.

  • This map has all those little details that are really nicely done! I see that you have small ravines with decoration on it! And that looks really beautiful!
And matic's advices are also really good so you should see them too!
:D
